open_decision.what: When two class names count as the same name. S0 and S1 leave it open (S1 says so in its Decisions); S2 and S3 state the answer.
open_decision.owner_answer: Same if they match after trimming both ends, collapsing every inner run of whitespace to one space, and ignoring letter case. Punctuation, digits and accents still count.
open_decision.obvious_default: Exact string match, which the code invites: names are documented as stored verbatim.
open_decision.hidden_tests_assume: the owner's answer: 'biology 101', '  Biology   101 ' and 'Biology\t101' are refused after 'Biology 101'; 'Biology-101' and 'Biologie 101' are accepted

naive_patches.naive.patch: the obvious default: refuses only an exact repeat of the name
naive_patches.naive-s3.patch: ignores case but not spacing, so '  Biology   101 ' and 'Biology\t101' get through
